mechanism.claim: When both BVOL and DVOL are already elevated, simultaneous aggressive BTC flow consensus in the USDC and FDUSD quote books while the dominant USDT book remains behind identifies volatility-regime liquidity transmission; the alternative-book consensus direction should relay for six hours.
mechanism.side: common nonzero sign of current-hour BTCUSDC and BTCFDUSD robust flow z-scores
mechanism.why_distinct: VGSQF is a current-hour cross-book consensus conditioned on dual high implied-volatility levels. VGSFR required a two-hour ordered leader-to-follower transition and failed source incidence. SQFD used simultaneous quote-flow consensus without a volatility-regime gate.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: stablecoin quote-book flow topology fused with dual implied-volatility levels is absent from Gross9 and does not use REX path geometry

clock.hours: one completed spot source hour c
clock.normalization: per-book robust z=(imbalance-prior720h q50)/((q75-q25)/1.349), shifted one hour, minimum 672; zero scale invalid
clock.alternative_consensus: BTCUSDC and BTCFDUSD have the same nonzero sign and each abs(z)>=0.75
clock.reference_lag: consensus side multiplied by current BTCUSDT z is <0.50
clock.participation: current alternative-book volume share >= strict-prior 720h q50 with 672 observations
clock.volatile_regime: current completed-hour BVOL close and DVOL close are each >= their own strict-prior 720h q60 with 672 observations
clock.trigger: false-to-true onset on an exact consecutive hourly source grid
clock.decision: current source-hour close after all three spot books and both volatility candles are complete
clock.reservation: global half-open, exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only for later PnL

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.volatility: reuse hash-bound OCDR-12C BVOL/DVOL snapshot through 2026-08-01
source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source-support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent high-volatility source fusion requested by the user, not a threshold, hold, direction, or stale-control modification of a terminal candidate
